title: CountyLosses
description: Crop insurance indemnity per year, county, crop and cause of loss, from RMA's cause-of-loss files. Published by the pipeline as county-losses.json; the UI reads it.

county_fips.description: State and county FIPS code, e.g. 19153.

crop.description: Commodity name as RMA records it, e.g. CORN.

cause.description: Cause of loss as RMA records it, e.g. Drought.

indemnity.description: Dollars and cents paid for losses. Unique per year, county_fips, crop and cause.
